TC-B-01.notes: Button element with visible text 'Entrar'. Proper semantic element and accessible name. No violations.

violations_found.description: Button element with no accessible name. No visible text and no aria-label provided.

TC-B-02.notes: Empty button with nested generic element containing no text. Button lacks programmatic label for assistive technologies.

violations_found.description: Generic element styled as button (cursor:pointer) instead of semantic button element. No role attribute to expose correct semantics.

TC-B-03.notes: Using generic DIV/SPAN with CSS cursor pointer instead of <button> element. Violates semantic HTML requirement for interactive controls.

TC-B-04.notes: Button element with visible text 'Confirmar'. Proper semantics and accessible name. No violations.

TC-B-05.notes: Button element with visible text 'Acessar sistema'. Proper semantics and accessible name. No violations.

TC-B-06.notes: Button element with visible text 'Excluir conta'. Proper semantics and accessible name. No violations.

violations_found.description: Mismatch between accessible name (aria-label='Cancelar') and visible text ('Confirmar'). Label in Name criterion requires accessible name to match or be part of visible text.

TC-B-07.notes: Button has aria-label='Cancelar' but visible text shows 'Confirmar'. This creates confusion for users as the announced name differs from what is displayed.

TC-B-08.notes: Button element with visible text 'Cancelar'. Proper semantics and accessible name. No violations.

TC-B-09.notes: Button element with icon/generic child and aria-label='Pesquisar'. Has accessible name via aria-label. Proper for icon buttons. No violations.

TC-B-10.notes: Button element with visible text 'Salvar alterações'. Proper semantics and accessible name. No violations.

TC-B-11.notes: Button element with visible text 'Confirmar'. Proper semantics and accessible name. No violations.

violations_found.description: Using anchor element (with href='#') for button action instead of button element. Links should navigate; actions should use button semantics.

TC-B-12.notes: Link element 'Excluir arquivo' with href='#' used as action button. Should use <button> element for actions, not <a> with href='#'.

TC-B-13.notes: Two button elements 'Voltar' and 'Próxima etapa' with visible text. Proper semantics and accessible names. No violations.

TC-B-14.notes: Button element with icon/generic child and aria-label='Filtrar resultados'. Has accessible name via aria-label. Proper for icon buttons. No violations.
